bio.text: Tom Suozzi represents New York's 3rd Congressional District, covering parts of Long Island and Queens, and was first elected to Congress in 2016.
He was Mayor of Glen Cove from 1994 to 2001 and Nassau County Executive from 2002 to 2009.
He is trained as an attorney and CPA, worked as a litigator at Shearman & Sterling and as a senior advisor at Lazard, and lives in Glen Cove.
